g.text: 2. POST callback: sessionId, msisdn, input text
3. Resolve msisdn to a linked identity, check the PIN, short-lived limited token
4. Token + who this person can book for (self, dependants)
5. CON menu, one page (at most 182 characters)
6. 'Who is this for?', consent, symptoms: one step at a time; state in the session store
7. Rules evaluation in the same step (under 100 ms): advice shown at once
8. Book: consultation + payment with mobile-money push (Idempotency-Key)
9. Create payment for the patient's share
10. END 'Approve the payment on your phone'
12. Webhook payment.succeeded, verified as in part 3
13. SMS: booking confirmed, a nurse will contact you
